name: Tech Debt / Refactor
about: Track technical debt and refactoring needs
title: "refactor: "
labels: ["refactor"]

**What needs to change**
Describe the current code and what's wrong with it (include file:line evidence where possible).

**Proposed approach**
How should we fix it?

**Impact**
What modules/components are affected? Any breaking changes?

**Priority**
- [ ] Blocking (must fix before next release)
- [ ] High (should fix this sprint)
- [ ] Medium (next few sprints)
- [ ] Low (nice to have)

> 踩坑/返工类请参照 `docs/postmortem/TEMPLATE.md` 沉淀 postmortem。
